caption: The drawing features a centered square composition with a symmetrical, geometric pattern. The pattern consists of a series of nested squares made up of small triangles and squares, all rendered in red and white. The outermost border is formed by a row of red right-angled triangles with their hypotenuses facing outward. Inside this border, subsequent layers alternate between rows of red triangles and white spaces, creating a stepped effect as the pattern moves toward the center. The innermost section contains a denser arrangement of small red triangles and squares, forming a star-like shape inside a central square. The entire geometric design is placed on a plain, off-white background, with ample blank space surrounding the central motif. The drawing uses only two colors: red for the patterned elements and white for the spaces and background.
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
